title: NTC and PTC thermistors: measuring temperature

spans.text: A thermistor's resistance changes with temperature: NTC resistance falls as temperature rises; PTC resistance rises. This helps measure temperature or protect circuits.
Connect the 10 kΩ fixed resistor between the board supply and A0, and the NTC between A0 and ground. Use 5 V for UNO and 3.3 V for ESP32.
The sketch estimates resistance in a divider. Accurate temperature needs the thermistor's Beta or Steinhart–Hart data, calibration, and the board's ADC range. Platform: Arduino or ESP32.

spans.title: Important safety note
spans.text: The nominal resistance and divider orientation matter. Never exceed the board's allowed ADC input voltage.
